sha_convention: sha256 over on-disk raw bytes (binary read, no line-ending normalization)
preregistered: The NS5 twin-collapse identity requires aligned twins; a permuted gate_proj row-pairing breaks it, so the measured gate-class R_spectral ratio deviates from sqrt(2) by >1%. Kill: permuted R within +/-0.1% of sqrt(2) ([1.4128, 1.4156]) -> constant is generic. Promote: deviation >1% (derivation owed separately). 0.1%-1%: INCONCLUSIVE-BY-RULE, widen with a second seed.
scope: null-model permuted-twin rider for the sqrt(2) gate-class R_spectral constant: reproduces the eps0.05_control anchor unmodified as an admissibility control, and separately measures R_spectral with the gate_proj row-duplication pairing PERMUTED (second-half rows shuffled, fixed disclosed seed) before the pushforward. NUMBERS + band classification per the frozen bands only -- no mechanism derivation attempted here; the coordinator adjudicates.

method.permutation_construction: gate_proj [ff, d_model] row-dup halves ga=W[:half], gb=W[half:]; gb_permuted = gb[perm] for a fixed torch.randperm(half, seed=PERMUTATION_SEED); up_proj/down_proj left at their original grown values in both variants (one-variable change).
method.capture: reproduces cbase_grow_rung2_gradpost_capture.py's capture_grad_post_gate exactly (same manual_seed(42) position, same build_v0_model + load_state_dict, same _build_pinned_batch, same QAT/CE/MTP per-microstep loop) with the grown checkpoint's state dict's gate_proj entry replaced by each variant.

anchor_control.construction: unmodified grown checkpoint (aligned gate_proj twins) -- reproduces the banked eps0.05_control anchor

permuted_twin.construction: gate_proj second-half rows permuted per fixed seed, first half + up_proj/down_proj unchanged

null_model_assessment.promote_band: deviation_pct > 1.0 (derivation owed separately, not attempted here)
null_model_assessment.inconclusive_band: 0.1 < deviation_pct <= 1.0 (widen with second seed before interpretation)
